```sql
SELECT AVG(first_innings_score) AS avg_first_innings_score
FROM (
    SELECT d.match_id, SUM(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_score
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.venue = 'M Chinnaswamy Stadium'
      AND d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id
) AS sub;
```
